text.tspan: WS3 - PART 3 - Dedicated Silo Agent Platform Architecture (Pattern B: Silo)
Tenant A Dedicated GCP Project, VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) & IAM PAB Sovereign Enclave (project-silo-tenant-a)
Dedicated Tenant A Project Governance & Control Plane (Inside VPC-SC)
Dedicated Tenant A Datastore, Vector Index & HSM CMEK
Dedicated tenant IdP • Principal Access Boundary (PAB)
Dedicated tenant catalog • Isolated tool & endpoint list
Dedicated Model Armor & DLP • Provisioned throughput
Tenant B Dedicated Sovereign Silo Project (project-silo-tenant-b)
Isolated VPC-SC • Dedicated Confidential GKE ADK Runtime • AlloyDB & Customer HSM CMEK
Tenant C Dedicated Sovereign Silo Project (project-silo-tenant-c)
Isolated VPC-SC • Dedicated Confidential GKE ADK Runtime • AlloyDB & Customer HSM CMEK
WHO RUNS WHAT IN PATTERN B (SOVEREIGN SILO) — ZERO SHARED INFRASTRUCTURE
Per-tenant GCP project, VPC-SC, PAB, 2 gateways & HSM CMEK
Dedicated stack per tenant; customer holds Cloud HSM key (<60s / 41.2s verified cryptographic halt).
Dedicated front end, Confidential GKE (AMD SEV-SNP), MCP & PT models
Zero shared compute pods or KV caches; hardware-encrypted RAM scales strictly per tenant silo.
Dedicated Valkey sessions + AlloyDB, BigQuery & HNSW vector index
Physical DB & HNSW index encrypted under customer CMEK with 0 shared tables or cache keys.
